mapper.select: SELECT version,CAST(policy_json AS CHAR) policy_json FROM member_cycle_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND version=#{version}
SELECT version,CAST(policy_json AS CHAR) policy_json FROM member_cycle_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND effective_from<=#{at} ORDER BY effective_from DESC,version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT version,CAST(policy_json AS CHAR) policy_json FROM member_cycle_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND version>#{after} ORDER BY version LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT member_id,occurred_at,contribution FROM member_cycle_contribution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_id=#{source}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_cycle_contribution SET contribution=#{amount} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_id=#{source}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(contribution),0) FROM member_cycle_contribution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND occurred_at>=#{from} AND occurred_at<#{to}
SELECT member_id,TRUE enabled,policy_version,cycle_start,cycle_end,current_growth,retention_growth,member_level,version FROM member_cycle_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_cycle_account SET policy_version=#{v.policyVersion},cycle_start=#{v.cycleStart},cycle_end=#{v.cycleEnd},current_growth=#{v.currentGrowth},retention_growth=#{v.retentionGrowth},member_level=#{v.memberLevel},version=#{v.version} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{v.memberId} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.sql: (r.item_id IS NULL OR (r.quarantined_at IS NULL AND r.retry_at<=#{at}))
mapper.select: SELECT m.tenant_id,m.member_id,r.attempts,r.transient_attempts FROM member_record m FORCE INDEX(ix_member_cycle_due) LEFT JOIN member_work_retry r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.lane='cycles' AND r.item_id=m.member_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.cycle_due_at<=#{at} AND ORDER BY m.cycle_due_at,m.member_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_record SET cycle_due_at=#{due} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member}
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(effective_from) FROM member_cycle_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND effective_from>#{at}
SELECT version,effective_from,rollout_cursor FROM member_cycle_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND rolled_out=FALSE ORDER BY effective_from,version LIMIT 1
SELECT member_id FROM member_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id>#{after} ORDER BY member_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_record SET cycle_due_at=#{due} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id>#{from} AND member_id<=#{to} AND cycle_due_at>#{due} AND cycle_due_at<'9999-12-31 00:00:00.000'
UPDATE member_cycle_policy SET rollout_cursor=#{cursor},rolled_out=#{done} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND version=#{version} AND rolled_out=FALSE AND rollout_cursor<=>#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)>0 FROM member_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND cycle_due_at<=#{at}
